# GeneratedCode — do not edit

Everything in this folder is generated by `pac modelbuilder build`, orchestrated by
`SupportTicket.EntityGenerator`. Manual changes are overwritten on the next run.

Expected layout after generation:

- `Entities/` — one early-bound class per table (`ogz_support_ticket`, `ogz_ticket_category`, ...)
- `OptionSets/` — global Choice enums
- service context / message classes, if enabled in the generator settings

Handwritten extensions (partial classes) belong outside this folder.
